raw_transcript:
Elena Vance [00:00:02]: Thanks everyone for joining today's discovery session for Metro Directory. Sarah, could you start by sharing your main goals and user feedback?

Sarah Miller [00:00:15]: Absolutely. Metro Directory currently lists about 15,000 local health and wellness providers. Our biggest bottleneck is search. Users are complaining that keyword search is too rigid. If someone types 'acupuncture for back pain', they get zero results because nobody has that exact string in their title.

Tom Chen [00:00:45]: Right. We need two primary search enhancements. First, multi-category faceted filtering: users must be able to filter simultaneously by specialty, insurance accepted, and weekend availability. Second, radius distance search where a visitor can enter their zip code and specify a radius slider from 5 to 50 miles.

David Ross [00:01:15]: Understood. Brilliant Directories has native location geocoding using Google Maps APIs. For the faceted filtering, we can configure sub-category filtering and custom member form fields.

Sarah Miller [00:01:30]: Great. The second major area is the mobile experience. More than 70% of our traffic is mobile. The current member profile pages take 4.5 seconds to load on 4G, and the search filter sidebar requires endless scrolling. We want a responsive slide-out filter drawer on mobile and optimized image loading with WebP formats.

Tom Chen [00:02:00]: Also, we do NOT want a separate native iOS or Android app right now. We explicitly decided against an App Store app because of the maintenance overhead. A fast, mobile-first progressive web experience is our target.

Elena Vance [00:02:20]: That's a very clear exclusion. What is your target timeline and budget expectation?

Sarah Miller [00:02:30]: We want to launch this in 6 weeks from kickoff to align with our Q4 marketing campaign. Our approved budget ceiling is around $15,000 to $18,000.

David Ross [00:02:45]: To summarize the key deliverables:
1. Multi-facet search filtering by category, insurance, and weekend availability.
2. Zip code radius distance search with 5 to 50 mile slider.
3. Mobile responsive overhaul with slide-out filter drawer and under 2-second profile loading.
4. Clear exclusion: No native iOS/Android apps.
5. Target timeline: 6 weeks.

Sarah Miller [00:03:15]: Exactly. That captures our requirements perfectly. Please prepare the scope of work and estimate.
